ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (central peduncle region and margins).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white blobs occupy the lateral regions of both lobes. A contiguous low-intensity black geometric mass extends from the center bottom (peduncle insertion) upwards, bifurcating slightly. High-frequency black mottling/speckling is mapped along the interior transition zones and distal trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped indentation; acute angle estimated at 40 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 120 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire horizontal boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 15 pixels between peak and valley, creating a jagged silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge exhibits a convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular 3D pixel formations (barnacles) are localized at the far left and far right distal tips. A single low-intensity circular indentation with a white center is visible in the lower-right dark region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible: specifically, four vertical marks on the left lobe and three diagonal marks on the right lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Colonization of barnacles on the trailing edge tips; prominent circular scar located in the right-central dark pigmentation area.
